info.title: Task API persistence and unfinished pagination

messages.text: Goal: build a task API. We prefer pytest for backend tests. Never commit credentials.

content.text:
We chose Postgres for concurrent writes and transaction support.
Created src/db.py with a pooled database connection.
Updated src/tasks.py to persist tasks.
Private reasoning must not be imported.

TODO: add cursor pagination to GET /tasks.
Next step: write an integration test for duplicate task IDs.
Constraint: keep the existing /tasks response fields stable.
